summary: Improve flock records, feed calculations and biosecurity routines with practical poultry farming training. Explore the course outline.
lede: Poultry farming training equips farm workers, supervisors and aspiring producers to manage flock operations and production records. You practise reviewing housing, feeding and flock-health routines, calculating feed conversion ratio, and maintaining vaccination, mortality and egg or meat production records. Applied exercises cover biosecurity checks, record review and corrective-action planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who handle poultry production, flock health, farm records or the decisions that shape daily broiler and layer operations.
prerequisites: Basic literacy and numeracy are useful for reviewing flock records and completing production calculations.
